recordingMethod: Chromium 151 CSS-pixel capture of forty-eight independent inert replays, split into ordinary and top-BREAK 24-case executions (local/opponent x active/sole bench x original clean group q1/q2/q3 x prior middle/base divergence x repeated same-other-lower group initiator), against the checked-in board surface. Construction through checkpoint 25 is inherited from a digest-pinned dependency; keyboard and clicked-card ingress are digest-pinned but not executed. The application module is stubbed, and only the immediate second whole-group single=false rotation by checkpoint 25’s same other lower initiator is retained as the measured transition.

provenanceClaims.claim: Plain-R keyboard ingress requests whole-group rotation for the selected lower card and forwards its logical index.
Repeated other-lower index-1-or-2 single=false turn mutation, sibling rotation, unchanged per-card BREAK flags, parity-sensitive margin rewrite, and action payload used by this capture.
Clicked lower-card ingress resolves the containing zone and the selected logical card index used by rotate-card.
